title: Test infrastructure — testcontainers-postgres + conftest.py
scope: Resolves INFRA-001 (analysis.json). Adds testcontainers[postgres]==4.9.0 to requirements-dev.txt then writes conftest.py that exposes 3 fixtures: pg_container (session-scoped, brings up PostgreSQL 16 in Docker, runs Base.metadata.create_all), db_session (per-test, SAVEPOINT-rolled-back), client (FastAPI TestClient bound to db_session via dependency override).
decisions_referenced: DS-002 (echo: real PG semantics needed for SELECT FOR UPDATE in S2)

success_criteria.manual: (a) `pip install -r backend/requirements-dev.txt` adds testcontainers. (b) `pytest backend/tests/ --collect-only` discovers the conftest fixtures without error.
success_criteria.automated: Implicitly used by all subsequent service + integration tests.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: 3 fixtures present; pg_container scope='session'; db_session uses SAVEPOINT for per-test isolation; client overrides get_db dependency.

checkout_prompt: 'Test infrastructure ready — testcontainers-postgres + 3 conftest fixtures (pg_container, db_session, client). INFRA-001 resolved.'
